title: Chapter 426
content:
Chapter 426

Just when the members of Shenxingdao were discussing to organize an investigation team to go to Jiangdu City, the imperial capital of the Imperial Kingdom, to investigate the cause of Elder Qingyun's death. In the Imperial Palace of Jiangdu City, a meeting on the sectarian management order in the empire was also held.

In the main hall of the court, Zhong Yu and the important officials of the Yigang Empire gathered together.

"Your Majesty, those sects of the powerful clan act without restraint. They have always acted according to their own hearts and have no regard for the laws of our empire. This time, the Taoist Shenxing is a clear proof. This situation must be investigated, and this phenomenon must be contained. Fearful of catastrophe." said Zhuang Xunfuzi, the former Confucian sage of Mingyue World in Qin Dynasty, who was in charge of criminal law in the Ministry of Criminal Affairs of the Empire.

Master Xun was a top-notch expert in the original world of Mingyue in the Qin Dynasty, almost comparable to Donghuang Taiyi, but a powerhouse who surpassed Gai Nie Funian's level.

Before, because of the constraints of the world, Master Xun was the same as the Eastern Emperor Taiyi, and it was difficult to break through.

After coming to this world, the level restrictions were completely relaxed, Master Xun and Donghuang Taiyi became one of the first few people under Zhong Yu's command to break through, several years faster than Gai Nie and others.

Even because of the accumulation of knowledge, those who were the first to break through, Master Xun, had already reached the late stage of the sixth order, and were not far from the peak.

It is possible to break through to the seventh level in a few years, and they are a group of talents that Zhong Yuji is looking for.

Zhong Yu looked at Master Xun, but understood his radical attitude. Although Xun Fuzi inherited Confucianism, his ideas did not match the benevolence and righteousness of Confucius and Mencius, and he was somewhat inclined to Legalism.

This can be seen from the fact that some of the most famous disciples he taught, such as Han Fei and Li Si, are famous figures in Legalism.

"Lord Xun said it right. These people from the powerful sects, relying on their own strength, don't pay attention to the laws and regulations of the empire. They act rampantly and cause even more disasters. They are an important source of local disasters. If they are not wiped out, the long-term stability of the empire will be just empty talk." Wei Zhuang, the chief officer of the arrest department, has a philosophy similar to that of Xun Fuzi, advocating the execution of punishment, and the same blow to criminals, so as to quell the chaos of the empire.

"But those sects of wealthy clans are powerful. Take Shen Xing Dao as an example. I heard that the Supreme Elder, Shen Xingzi, is a seventh-rank earth immortal with unfathomable strength. There are also 13 sect masters and a group of elders in the sect. The thirteen sons of the Divine Star are all sixth-level celestial masters, and it is quite difficult to take them down." Gai Nie, who had seen the power of these sects when he went out with Zhong Yu before, said hesitantly.

"Master Gai is right. A mere immortal has such power. All the powerful clans in our empire add up to about ten seventh ranks, and nearly a hundred sixth ranks. If you want to subdue this powerful force, It's easier said than done." Zhao Yun, who was trained by Zhong Yu and spent a lot of resources, said.

"It's not too difficult to deal with these powerful clans. Although these powerful clans are very powerful together, it may be quite difficult for our empire to deal with them. However, these people belong to various forces, and there are deep conflicts between them. , It is basically impossible to unite, and it is impossible to form a powerful force." Cao Cao, the general of Zhengnan, said.

"As long as the empire can defeat Shenxing Dao in the first place, and eliminate the strongest forces in the territory. With the power of exterminating the sect, the other weak, small sects and wealthy families scattered all over the place will definitely not dare to stop them, and they will definitely surrender one after another. , even if there are some stubborn people, they will not be able to turn the waves."

"And take this opportunity to take advantage of the opportunity to recruit those strong people in the territory, integrate them under the empire's command, and incorporate them into the system. At that time, the empire will be able to add dozens of sixteenth ranks, several seventh ranks, and become more powerful."

"Okay. What Cao Aiqing said is true. A mere sectarian powerful family can give up under the army of our empire. I don't know if Cao Aiqing has a plan." Zhong Yu was overjoyed and praised quickly.

"There is a general strategy, but there is one key missing. Without it, all the plans would be empty talk." Cao Cao said hesitantly.

"What's the key point, Aiqing may as well just say it, as long as I can do it, I will definitely support it with all my strength." Zhong Yu said without hesitation, as long as it is for the great cause of the empire, he can give up anything.

"The key point of these strategies is how to quickly defeat the gods. Although there are endless sixth-order powerhouses in the empire, the number has already surpassed the number of gods. No, how to deal with the seventh-level earth immortals of the Shenxing Dao is really a difficulty, and I am afraid that His Majesty will need to take action. The ministers are incompetent, and they are really shameless." Cao Cao said with some shame.

"So that's the case, Ai Qing, don't worry, it's just a seventh-level earth fairy, just flipping his palms. At that time, I will personally drive and conquer, and use the brilliant heavenly power to frighten Xiaoxiao in all directions, and show my great imperial power." Zhong Yu thought for a while, although he already had It's a bit of a loss for the emperor to do it himself, but for the sake of the great cause, this is nothing, and now is not the time to sit back and enjoy the success.

"In this way, with His Majesty's divine power, these little things will surely be wiped out, and the territory of our empire will also be completely peaceful, only thanks to Your Majesty's bravery." Cao Cao flattered.

In this way, some details were discussed in the follow-up, and the plan was continuously improved. One day later, a shocking conspiracy against all the powerful clans in the empire has been completed and is about to kick off.

On the third day when Zhong Yu dealt with Taoist Shenxing, through the efforts of everyone in the court, an army of 100,000 people has been formed.

And quickly rushed towards the direction of the God Star Road, preparing to start a mountain-breaking temple dominated by the empire, so as to unify the order of the world and delineate the boundaries of the extraordinary.

At this time, in the palace group of Shenxing Dao, a group of big bosses are still arguing about who to send to investigate and which disciples to bring, which fully reflects the low efficiency of these sects.

Although Yuguo has assembled an army of 100,000 people for some reason, and the action is a bit big, but no one thought, nor could it be imagined that the goal of this army is to target all the wealthy clans in the territory, and the first goal is the territory of Yuguo The most powerful sect, God Star Dao.

Three days later, the 100,000 troops arrived at the foot of Shenxing Peak on Shenxingdao, working overtime day and night, with the blessing of countless supernatural powers and secret methods.

The top management of Shenxingdao finally decided who to send to investigate, and they are preparing a batch of materials, making preparations for the departure.

When the army arrived, the entire sect suddenly realized that a great war that could threaten the sect's survival was coming.
